title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from the ruins of battle.
pitch: As the sentient core of a fallen Titan, you must tactically dismantle enemies to salvage components and restore your mech. Make strategic decisions that affect your capabilities and explore the consequences of your choices in fast-paced, real-time combat.
coreLoop: Read the enemy's attack intent, evade or interrupt their strikes, target their subsystems, and dismantle them for salvage. Choose wisely how to handle your loot to shape your mech's abilities.

mechanics.name: Enemy Dismantling
mechanics.description: Target enemy subsystems to dismantle while considering the consequences of each choice.

mechanics.name: Three-way Loot Decision
mechanics.description: Choose between installing components for immediate benefits, securing them for later, or dismantling for immediate repairs.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, Mouse for aiming and targeting
controls.mouse: Left click to interact and shoot

difficulty.start: Introduce one enemy with clear attack patterns.
difficulty.progression: Increase enemy speed and complexity of attack telegraphs.
difficulty.peak: Introduce the need for quick decision-making in the three-way loot choice.

winLose.win: Secure the loot and extract successfully.
winLose.lose: Fail to evade or dismantle the enemy, leading to loss of integrity.

scopeNotes: Do not build procedural dungeons, economy/shop, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, upgrades between runs, narrative scenes beyond one line of flavor text, or save systems beyond engine defaults.

scoreEvents: Score increases when successfully dismantling enemies and making loot decisions.
